sources.summary: Glossary for the City of Our Future Gathers Experts to Reflect on the Cities of Tomorrow with Hope What kind of city do we want to build for future generations? This is the central question of Glossary for the City of Our Future with Hope , a book organized and edited by architect and professor Thereza Christina Couto Carvalho. The launch will take place on September 28 at 6:30 PM at Livraria da Travessa in Ipanema, Rio de Janeiro. Published by Rio Books, the book brings together 47 contributors—including researchers, architects, urban planners, and experts from various fields—to offer an interdisciplinary reflection on contemporary challenges.
